name: Glade spirits
slug: Ethereal undead spirits drawn to the lantern and pulled into Sylan.
description: A small group of cloudy, semi-translucent figures, unseen until a lantern shows the Ethereal Plane. Divine Sense reads them as undead: spectral spirits made physical, with no subtype. They look much alike. One is fitter, with a large wound down the center of his face, read as a killing blow. The nearest has a gaunt face and crazed eyes and is only half solidified. Sylan and Ord take them for spirits from Old Navel, stirred when the party passed. Whether they are from Morgan is unanswered.

log.summary: About six were already milling around Sylan in the woods, half above him and half passing through him. The nearest startles at the lantern, grabs the staff's crook, answers Ord with a wail inside the head, and frays at the edges like burnt paper. The other five howl and move toward the lantern; three or four pull on it while the first is about half gone. When Sylan grabs the staff they erupt into incomplete physical bodies and, within about four feet, are vacuumed into him. He does not recognize them and feels no change. They had been ethereal and become more material and black-shaded as the staff acts. Absorbed spirits read as light-producing; the ones still outside are shaded black and are not. Those not yet taken crawl against the pull and cannot break it. Four are taken. Two remain: Ledzbika, and then the sickly elderly woman. A raspy, unnamed voice says people stole from him, that he was pulled from his floorboards when the party walked by, and that their friend is sucking them in. After the beacon dies, no more spirits close in. At about sixty feet, hands and silhouettes still flash at the forest edge and do not approach.

Are they from Old Navel, from Morgan, or from somewhere else?
